snippet.title: So to Speak Trailer for BitSummit THE 8th BIT - 2021
snippet.description:
So to Speak is a video game in development about learning the Japanese language. Excited to be participating remotely in BitSummit 2021!

http://www.sotospeakgame.com

Developed by Erik Andersen. Music by Greg Andersen.
